name: Terminal
pitch: For infrastructure and live-coding talks where the audience lives in a shell and the deck should feel like one long tmux session.

illustration.medium: flat vector on near-black, like a TUI with amber and mint green accents
illustration.line: 1 to 2px strokes, monospace-grid aligned, square caps
illustration.shapes: rectangles, box-drawing frames, block cursors, no curves beyond small status dots
illustration.palette_use: dark background dominant, amber accent and mint green accent used one or two per image
illustration.avoid: gradients, 3D, photos, rounded blobs, drop shadows
